meta.source: Created from scratch for Treeline (no prior brand sources). v2: watercolor and nature.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background: warm papyrus, a solid color. Leave most of it bare.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and inputs: a lighter, solid sheet laid on the papyrus.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells, the track of a switch, pressed rows.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover tint on rows and quiet buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines that fade at both ends (see Gradients). Decorative only.

tokens.name: card-edge
tokens.usage: The faint 1px edge on every card and sheet, so it lifts off `canvas` without a hard line.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, checkboxes, switch off): 3:1 on `surface` and `canvas` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `canvas`, `surface`, `surface-sunk` and every wash.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `canvas`, `surface`, `surface-sunk` and every wash. 4.5:1 on all.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled labels only; 3:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: canopy
tokens.usage: Brand green: primary buttons, on states, links. One canopy action per view.

tokens.name: canopy-light
tokens.usage: The lit top of a canopy gradient. Text on it is still `on-canopy`.

tokens.name: canopy-strong
tokens.usage: Pressed primary; canopy text on `canopy-soft` and `wash-leaf`.

tokens.name: canopy-soft
tokens.usage: Small leaf tint for tags and icon wells only. Never a card or page background.

tokens.name: on-canopy
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `canopy` and `canopy-light`.

tokens.name: bark
tokens.usage: Warm wood: household names, parent-set states. Text on `canvas`, `surface`, `bark-soft`, `wash-bark`.

tokens.name: bark-soft
tokens.usage: Solid plank tint.

tokens.name: sunbeam
tokens.usage: Sunlight: the ringing state and the Answer button. A fill or glow, never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: sunbeam-soft
tokens.usage: Solid sunlight tint.

tokens.name: on-sunbeam
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `sunbeam`.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Quiet hours, night, information. Text on `canvas`, `surface`, `sky-soft`, `wash-sky`.

tokens.name: sky-soft
tokens.usage: Solid sky tint.

tokens.name: berry
tokens.usage: Danger and blocked. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: berry-soft
tokens.usage: Solid error tint behind field messages.

tokens.name: on-berry
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `berry`.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Nighttime card: a deep night-sky sheet. Text on it is `on-night`.

tokens.name: night-low
tokens.usage: The lighter lower sky of a night card's gradient.

tokens.name: on-night
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `night` and `night-low`.

tokens.name: on-night-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `night` and `night-low`.

tokens.name: moon
tokens.usage: The moon and stars on a night card. Never text.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: The sun disc on a sun card: warmer and brighter than `sunbeam`. Never text.

tokens.name: wash-leaf
tokens.usage: Translucent leaf pigment for small things: tags, icon wells, the approved half of a pairing. Never a large background.

tokens.name: wash-sky
tokens.usage: Translucent sky pigment: quiet hours, night, the page's upper corner.

tokens.name: wash-sun
tokens.usage: Translucent sunlight: ringing glows, new things.

tokens.name: wash-bark
tokens.usage: Translucent wood: household blooms.

tokens.name: wash-petal
tokens.usage: Translucent petal: the warm edge of a dusk gradient. Never alone as an error.

tokens.name: wash-mist
tokens.usage: Warm neutral mist: hover, skeletons, waiting states.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 3:1 on every ground and wash.

tokens.name: avatar-moss
tokens.usage: Avatar pigment. Text `ink`. Assigned by name, never by status.

tokens.name: avatar-acorn
tokens.usage: Avatar pigment. Text `ink`.

tokens.name: avatar-pond
tokens.usage: Avatar pigment. Text `ink`.

tokens.name: avatar-petal
tokens.usage: Avatar pigment. Text `ink`.

tokens.name: avatar-sun
tokens.usage: Avatar pigment. Text `ink`.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind sheets and dialogs: a soft veil, not a blackout.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Marketing heroes and the wordmark. One per screen at most. Set with font-variation-settings: "SOFT" 100.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Screen titles in the parent app.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: Row titles: a friend's name, a schedule name.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Calls only connect when both families say yes.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Sam can call Alex and Grandma.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Tiny section labels. Set in uppercase via text-transform.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Clock times and big counts, in the display face. Use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: Flush.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudge, tag inner gap.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside small controls.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; tag padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; row inner gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact), list row padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Compact card padding (rows, dense lists).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Default card padding; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; section spacing within a screen.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between major sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Screen top padding on large layouts.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Around section titles on large layouts.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Hero breathing room.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Open sky above a hero or empty state. Airy, not empty.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, speed-dial keys.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, list rows, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, hero panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags, switches, avatars: rounded like river stones.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Toned washes and anything on `surface-sunk`.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards at rest, inputs: a close contact shadow plus a soft warm haze, so sheets lift off the page.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, menus.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets and dialogs only.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Sunlight around a ringing phone or the Answer button. Nowhere else.

size.note: Fixed sizes for controls and marks.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons in dense parent lists.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary actions on phones.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside tags and small buttons.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons and rows.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Standalone icons and icon buttons.

tokens.name: avatar-sm
tokens.usage: Avatars in tags and dense rows.

tokens.name: avatar-md
tokens.usage: Avatars in list rows.

tokens.name: avatar-lg
tokens.usage: Profile headers.

layout.note: Widths, gutters and breakpoints. Breakpoints can't be used inside media queries as variables; copy the values.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Widest content column in the parent app on desktop, centered.

tokens.name: reading-max
tokens.usage: Longest line of running text (about 65 characters of `body`).

tokens.name: sheet-max
tokens.usage: Forms, dialogs, single cards and sheets on large screens.

tokens.name: gutter-sm
tokens.usage: Page side margins when the content area is under 600px (phones).

tokens.name: gutter-md
tokens.usage: Page side margins when the content area is 600–959px.

tokens.name: gutter-lg
tokens.usage: Page side margins when the content area is 960px or wider.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: tablet and up. Two card columns become possible.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: desktop and up. Content centers at `content-max`.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: wide desktop. List and detail can sit side by side with room to spare.

tokens.name: appbar-h
tokens.usage: Top app bar height on phones; 64px (`appbar-h-lg`) from 768px up.

tokens.name: appbar-h-lg
tokens.usage: Top app bar height on tablets and desktop.

tokens.name: tabbar-h
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar height on phones, plus the device safe area.

tokens.name: rail-w
tokens.usage: Icon nav rail on tablets (768–1023px).

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: Labeled side navigation on desktop (1024px and up).

tokens.name: list-pane
tokens.usage: List column in a list and detail layout when content is 960px or wider.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tappable area in any direction, even when the visible control is smaller.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Dividers and card edges in `line`.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox and switch borders in `line-strong`.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width, offset 2px.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls, applied to the whole control.

tokens.name: opacity-pressed
tokens.usage: Momentary press on image-like controls (avatars).

tokens.name: z-raised
tokens.usage: Sticky headers.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Scrims and sheets.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Transient notices above sheets.
